items.explanation: Com Ana (she), o verbo ganha s.

items.question: Leia: "Tom is twelve. He lives in Natal. His sister Ana is nine." Quantos anos o Tom tem?
items.explanation: "Tom is twelve": doze. Nove é a idade da Ana.
